evidence.free_tier_description: Every Hugging Face user receives monthly credits to experiment with Inference Providers
evidence.compute_denial_mechanism: Credit exhaustion blocks inference until credits purchased

impact.description: Free tier users get only $0.10/month in inference credits (~1000 requests on cheap models). Compute access denied after credit exhaustion unless payment provided. This creates compute denial for open-source researchers and developers who cannot afford PRO/Team tiers.

remediation.notes: Structural limitation of freemium model; no formal appeal process for credit increases
